//: Pins the SDK for the build gate, so CI compiles with the same analyzer binaries as a developer machine. <AnalysisLevel>latest-recommended</AnalysisLevel> plus warnings-as-errors (CLAUDE.md section 6) means 'latest' tracks the SDK: CI was resolving the 10.0.3xx feature band while development ran 10.0.1xx, and the newer analyzers failed the build on code that had been clean for phases. rollForward is 'disable' on purpose — a near-enough SDK is exactly what this prevents. Bump deliberately, then fix what the newer analyzers find.
